pc.notes: Captions and playback use newer compatible components.

history.notes:
Playback components updated on PC.
Automatic maintenance now checks compatibility before activation.

Playback and browser components are updated for PC, TV and phone.
Speech and caption engines are updated, with daily checks for new versions.
TV channel changes avoid unnecessary picture and audio restarts.
TV Sources menu is slightly smaller and positioned at the bottom-left.

Channel sources are available during playback.
Open audio and subtitles directly from the TV controls.
Logo cards are cleaner and background writes are less frequent.

TV navigation stays responsive while channel mappings load.
Artwork and playlist caches load in smaller batches.

Watch Home now has personal shelves and clearer browsing.
Reorder favorite channels with your mouse or TV remote.
Browse movies and series by year and genre.
Sports preview is larger. Cards stay compact and the guide refreshes on entry.
Sports now has wider landscape cards and a compact player above the events.
